evidence.note: 'On-time departures on 12 Cross-town fell a further 4 points' in October with phase 3 closing Mill Street; reader note 1 (#s7-oct) cites the OVT performance dashboard, October 2026, with a link.

'Evening closures, Planning's reading'; note 2 (#s7-plan) states planning's attribution to the Mill Street closures and links the Depot staffing report, Oct 2026 (dispute recorded). The source is cited, though a depot report is an odd home for planning's view.
'6 driver vacancies'; note 3 (#s7-depot) links the Depot staffing report, Oct 2026, and marks the manager's view as a paraphrase.
'Only 12 and 14 Cross-town dipped'; note 4 (#s7-annot) repeats the claim and links the OVT performance dashboard, October 2026.

rationale: Every number, date and factual claim on the slide (the 4-point fall, the phase 3 evening closures, the 6 vacancies, only routes 12 and 14 dipping) has a reader note with a linked source. Citing planning's reading to the depot staffing report is a questionable source choice, but the claim is still traceable to a cited source. That matches the pass descriptor.
